_provenance.note: Primary source is KONECT (single file with sign AND timestamp). The earlier SNAP + dynamic-networks join was verified to produce byte-identical output (0 sign, 0 time mismatches on all 841,372 edges), and is kept as a fallback. Rebuild with laundering/build_epinions.py --konect <out.epinions>.
_provenance.konect_fetch_note: konect.cc times out on port 443 from this host but serves the same file on port 80; scrape the download path from the network page rather than guessing the filename.
_provenance.citation: @MISC{konect:2017:epinions} (Koblenz Network Collection). Signed edge set originally: J. Leskovec, D. Huttenlocher, J. Kleinberg: Signed Networks in Social Media. CHI 2010.
_provenance.timestamp_caveat: 68.8% of edges (578,996 of 841,372, measured by build_epinions.py) share the crawl timestamp t0=979081200 (2001-01-09); only the other 31.2% carry a true formation time. Published analysis of the same data reports the same ~69%. See laundering/epinions_temporal.md.
_provenance.time_slots_rationale: T=22, the same as both Bitcoin datasets, so the held-out snapshot size and the epoch budget transfer unchanged. Requires snapshot_mode=quantile: with equal-count cuts, 69% of edges share one crawl timestamp and 14 of 22 snapshots come out empty (measured); quantile cuts leave zero empty.

fl.measured_snapshot_sizes: T=22 -> 578,996 in snapshot 0 (the t0 block), 6,042..8,820 in each later snapshot, 8,192 in the held-out snapshot 21
fl.memory_note: s3r_frugal_scan is REQUIRED here: the default SSM path builds dA and dBu at [131828, 21, 64, 4] = 2.64 GiB each and OOMs at 21.3 GiB peak. With node_chunk=4096 the peak is 16.5 GiB and a training epoch takes ~15s. The frugal scan is bit-exact against the default on values and gradients; see laundering/frugal_ssm.py.
